findings.title: Exit code 3 is reserved by Picocli for execution errors
findings.body: This change sets RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE to 3 while the preceding comment explicitly refers to picocli.CommandLine.ExitCode. In that interface, 3 is EXECUTION_ERROR. A normal incompatibility result (recreate required) would therefore be indistinguishable from an execution failure if Picocli or any handler returns the standard EXECUTION_ERROR code. The documented contract reserves 1 for unexpected errors, so use a non-picocli-reserved code for recreate (e.g. keep 4 for recreate and move feature-disabled to another value such as 5).

findings.title: Exit-code contract is not asserted by the new tests
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the stderr message and does not assert that the process exits with CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED (4). Likewise, testWrongVersions checks the error messages for incompatible Keycloak/Infinispan versions but never asserts exit code 3, even though this PR changes the recreate exit code from 4 to 3 and documents it. Since exit codes are the scripting contract for this tool, the tests should assert them to prevent regressions such as the code returning the old exit code while the docs show the new one.
